notes.title: The Volcanic Major Update!
notes.content:
Double The Platforming -> The Same Cheap Price!

The Volcanic Update brings about the new Volcanic Mode to Purrate Adventure: Volcano Isle, in this mode you will experience:

A more challenging version of the Isle (don't run out of lives!)
Secrets to be discovered with the addition of player-triggered cutscenes
Reworked and newer areas of the Isle


[previewyoutube=Mu3QZA4ICEE;full][/previewyoutube]

This Major Update also brings additions and fixes:

New Soundtrack for Volcanic Mode
Character Walk/Sprint animation now responds/changes to the player's speed
Added tips and new texts to Death & Game Over Screens
FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT
Golden power-ups will not be lost on death prior to finding a checkpoint
Added information for Spin Jump in the tutorial (Normal Mode)
Additional SFX have been implemented (Volcanic Mode)
3 New Steam Achievements
Credits Menu has been updated (Main Menu to access)
Intro Screen for Unreal Engine & Chai Games added to the game start-up


Following this major update in the weeks to come will be minor updates to commit any needed fixes or issues players may run into, please give your feedback in this survey and it will directly impact the future of this game: https://forms.gle/HFFJSe7sW3i7Nnvp6

Purrate Adventure is developed by one developer with the hope of creating fun & affordable games for everyone! 

Thank you for purchasing and playing Purrate Adventure!

notes.title: Purrate Adventure: Volcano Isle comes to Steam with a new update!
notes.content:
Purrate Adventures Steam release update aims to give the game more Polish, replayability and additional features!


All changes in this update include:

- New Animations

- New Spin attack and reworked Spin Jump

- Improved jumping from moving platforms

- Partial Controller Support

- Steam Achievements

- End-screen for leaving the Isle, displays your overall adventurer rating!

- Save System fully fixed

- Improved Main Menu soundtrack

- UI improvements on the Main Menu

- Additional SFX & Foley audio added in-game

- Hardcore Mode Teaser

Purrate Adventure: Volcano Isle has listened closely to player feedback and testing throughout its development which has directly impacted all its fixes, additions and changes. And this will continue throughout any future updates.

If you would like to give feedback on Purrate Adventure: Volcano Isle that will directly affect the future of this game, please take this survey: https://forms.gle/Fi5KmtELHTJPXSrq6

Thank You!
